entities.summary: Collier's was an American general interest magazine founded in 1888 by Peter Fenelon Collier. It was launched as Collier's Once a Week, then renamed in 1895 as Collier's Weekly: An Illustrated Journal, shortened in 1905 to Collier's: The National Weekly and eventually to simply Collier's. The magazine ceased publication with the issue dated the week ending January 4, 1957. In November of 2025, Collier's Magazine title was purchased by LNN USA a New Jersey based media company that is currently preparing re-launch of the publication for Summer of 2026.
